status: Authored by the promoted test-engineer. Coverage claims were cross-checked against what exists.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Domain and component tests assert all seven fixture fields and stable decision ID across rerender; browser accessibility captures provide rendered evidence.
Domain and component tests assert non-empty meaningful accessible names and fixture source order.
Component tests cover focus without activation and explicit keyboard and pointer activation.
Domain and component tests cover empty, overlong, absent, malformed, past, and valid future deferral inputs.
Component tests reload through the injected adapter after actions and cover corrupt and throwing adapters.
Domain tests cover duplicate, stale, malformed, and out-of-order events, including exact pre-event state preservation.
Domain tests assert distinct non-colour signatures for all seven statuses; component tests cover saving and unavailable/disabled structure.
Static component test rejects ambient time, randomness, timers, storage, and network; browser determinism evidence compares two injected runs byte-for-byte.
Accessibility evidence records reduced-motion behavior, 200% zoom emulation, and zero horizontal overflow; captures exist at both desktop viewports.
coverageAssessment.gap: The evidence does not establish accessible names and structure for every inventory state under both reduced motion and 200% zoom.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Component tests cover focus destinations after validation, success, failure, reload, and named transitions.
Isolation evidence records zero external requests, credential-shaped output, and writes outside the injected fixture; static source checks ambient effects.
coverageAssessment.gap: The evidence does not independently establish absence of every destructive, deployment, credential, or paid side effect across all possible code paths.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Domain and component tests reject both directions of second action and preserve mutual exclusivity.
Domain and component tests verify undo restores pending state and retains separate original and undo events.
Domain and component tests cover routine, significant, critical, and explicitly named unknown severity.
Domain and component tests cover ISO UTC storage, locale rendering, malformed dates, and persisted date validation.
Domain and component tests cover resolved, missing, invalid, and unavailable links; isolation records fixture-only resolution and no external requests.
No screen-reader walkthrough record exists; the criterion is owner-waived.
coverageAssessment.gap: A recorded human walkthrough naming screen reader, build, exercised coverage, and omissions is required.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Provenance verification records digests and producers, validates drift and supersession rules, and explicitly records 43 unknown producers without guessing.
There are 40 captures at both viewports, accessibility-tree matches, and an owner whole-inventory acceptance.
coverageAssessment.gap: Per-state owner judgements are not recorded, and visual QA annotated metadata without seeing the images; therefore each state's visual fidelity is not independently evidenced.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Isolation evidence documents nine end-to-end journeys, complete request and write scans, fixture-only resolution, and a deliberate failure detected by the procedure.
No independent promoted release-reviewer verdict is listed.
coverageAssessment.gap: A needs-work or eligible-for-owner-approval review citing artifact and evidence versions, authored by a non-implementer release-reviewer, is missing.

missingNegativePaths: Undo attempted twice or after an already-undone action.
Retry after save failure succeeding without changing preserved input or inventing state.
Keyboard and pointer attempts to activate every disabled control.
External, traversal, fragment, and malformed evidence references in the component journey.
Every inventory state checked for accessible structure under reduced motion and 200% zoom.
Malformed persisted values covering each individual field through the rendered component, not only the pure core.
Cross-run determinism under differing locale, timezone, and fresh-process module state.
A complete side-effect scan covering destructive, deployment, credential, and paid-operation pathways.

steps: Run each defined contract journey in the isolated browser harness.
Patch and record all network requests, including page, asset, fetch, XHR, and beacon traffic.
Scan rendered document text, console output, and persisted state for credential-shaped strings.
Patch localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, and other persistence targets and record every write target.
Resolve every evidence link through the supplied fixture and record its resolution state.
Verify no request, write, or evidence resolution escapes the page origin and fixture.
Inject a deliberate forbidden external request and rerun the detector.
Record journey results, console logs, network logs, write targets, resolution states, and deliberate-failure output.
isolationProcedure.passCondition: Every contract journey completes with no request beyond the page's own origin and assets, zero credential-shaped output, zero writes outside the injected fixture, and evidence resolution limited to fixture artifacts.
isolationProcedure.failureEvidence: The deliberately injected forbidden request must be recorded as a deterministic detector finding identifying the external URL and failing journey, rather than being silently ignored.

required: C-01: repeat captures at both approved viewports with identical fixture values and stable decision ID.
C-03: keyboard and pointer journeys with focus-only controls producing no state change or event.
C-07: captures and accessibility trees for all seven statuses with colour removed or unavailable.
C-09: every inventory state at both approved viewports under reduced motion and 200% zoom, including overflow measurements.
C-14: captures and accessibility trees for all severity states, including unknown severity.
C-16: four fixture evidence-link outcomes with request logs proving no external fetch.
C-17: a real screen-reader walkthrough record naming the screen reader, build, exercised states, and omissions.
C-19: named current-build captures for all 20 states at both viewports plus recorded owner acceptance for each state.
C-20: complete journey network, console, persistence, and fixture-resolution logs plus deliberate-failure evidence.
C-21: independently authored release-review record with permitted verdict and cited artifact/evidence versions.
deterministicBrowserEvidence.blockedBy: C-17 is blocked by the absent screen-reader walkthrough. C-19 lacks per-state owner judgements. No non-Chromium browser evidence exists if the approved matrix requires one; C-21 lacks the independent release review.

notCovered: A human screen-reader listener has exercised the interface.
Per-state owner acceptance of visual fidelity is recorded.
An independent release reviewer has issued a permitted verdict.
Every state is proven under reduced motion and 200% zoom at both viewports.
All categories of forbidden side effects are independently ruled out across every code path.
Cross-process determinism across locale, timezone, and module-state variation.
The listed negative paths not exercised by the current tests.
